notes.title: New Updates Coming
notes.notes:
The Glade is still in it's early stages and we've received some really great user feedback so far about ways to improve the game. There are lots of improvements coming, but a few upcoming changes are listed here:

 - ammo indicator (shows how much ammo you have left in the clip and how much you have left overall), as well as some explanation about how much ammo you get each round, etc

- more explanation of the points system and brief indication of how many points you received after killing an enemy

- leaderboard to see where you rank compared to others playing the game in overall high score

If there's anything you think the game is missing or could be improved, we're always open to hearing your feedback via kellyvrstudios@gmail.com

notes.title: Oculus Headset Bug Fix
notes.notes: We just released an update this morning to fix some issues users were having with an 'Authentication Error' when trying to launch the game on Steam with an Oculus Rift headset. This bug should have been fixed in this update. If you experience any other issues, please contact us via kellyvrstudios@gmail.com
